text:
Mateo Rivera: Quick sync: vendor roadmap alignment for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. We need SKU mapping for marketplace, SI readiness matrix, and joint announce windows. Can we do 8am PT Thurs for a 30m? cc @Alice @Priya @Leah
Alice Chen: Works for me. I have a partial cert matrix — will paste short notes after.
Priya Patel: 8am PT OK. Press wants a tentative embargo window: target late May for the H200 wave. We need firm firmware ETA from vendors.
Jin Wu: For MI300 we're still waiting on microcode from vendor; ETA rumored ~3 weeks. I'll ping the vendor contact. Also lab capacity: we can run 4 SI cert runs concurrently, but image tagging queue is ~2 days.
Omar Haddad: Lab note: power/thermal test bench booked next week. If we push SI runs into that window, we might need to extend by a day. Also cc @Victor for marketplace SKU tagging pipeline.
Victor Lang: I've updated the SKU mapping spreadsheet -> https://redwood.internal/sheets/gpu-sku-map (shared). Can you confirm tag format? prefer `redwood/gpu:<vendor>-<sku>-<region>`
Leah Park: SI PM here — timeline dependency: SIs need dev images by May 10 to complete integration before late-May announce. Can we aim to freeze images by May 7?
Mateo Rivera: Noted. Action items: Jin ping vendor microcode, Victor freeze tag schema, Alice share cert matrix, Leah confirm SI dev image list. I'll send calendar invite. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary images for H200-B200 testbed created (tag: redwood/gpu:nvidia-h200-canary). Logs: /ci/9876
Alice Chen: Cert matrix excerpt:
- H100: pass (kernel 5.19, cuDNN 9)
- H200: pending firmware, thermal margin tests
- Gaudi: needs build flag toggles
I'll upload full sheet to the shared folder.
Priya Patel: :eyes: pushing for joint press sync. Who owns the crosscloud fallback statement? Need comms sign-off.
Mateo Rivera: I'll draft fallback blurb; Leah + Victor review. Meeting invite sent. Last note: avoid public embargo until vendor confirms firmware ETA.
